nodes.description: Private owner address; sole authority for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate and privileged minting.
Public mapping of holder balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Private per-address counter of sales used by condition to throttle transfers from a given address.
Private whitelist mapping granting unconditional transfers to an address; set by _mints.
Private minimum transfer amount (with decimals applied) enforced by condition.
Private maximum transfer amount (with decimals applied) enforced by condition.
Private cap on the number of sales permitted per address, checked by condition.
Privileged trade address bypassing the sale conditions in ensure; set by setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address granted a bypass in ensure.
Public total token supply set in the constructor and mutated by _mints.
Public constant decimals value (18) used for scaling sale limits and mint amounts.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view guard checking owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelists before falling back to condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks, ensure checks and unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any restrictions.
Internal view sale-condition checker enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall to any address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Owner/backdoor-address-only mint function that assigns arbitrary balances and whitelists the target.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only loop distributing _value tokens to an array of recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter that stores the address allowed to bypass the sale conditions.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using CREATE2 init code hash.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and the initial allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for authorization and transfer/allowance bookkeeping.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, an arithmetic underflow risk.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom, an arithmetic overflow risk.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom, an arithmetic underflow risk.
Privileged arbitrary balance overwrite in _mints granting unlimited tokens and whitelist access.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, an arithmetic overflow risk.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transfer.
Source address parameter _from of ensure/transferFrom.
Destination address parameter _to of ensure/transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value of ensure/transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve.
Target address parameter a of delegate.
Arbitrary calldata parameter b of delegate.
Beneficiary address parameter spender of _mints.
Mint amount parameter addedValue of _mints.
Sale-count cap parameter saleNum of init.
Minimum sale amount parameter token of init.
Maximum sale amount parameter maxToken of init.
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend.
Address parameter addr of setTradeAddress.
Loop index i iterating the recipient array in batchSend.
Loop-local recipient _to extracted from the array in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length used to debit the sender in batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address computed via pairFor inside ensure.

edges.reason: transfer forwards the call to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
msg.sender is passed as _from into transferFrom from transfer.
msg.sender governs the allowance check and allowance debit in transferFrom.
approve stores allowance keyed by msg.sender without restriction.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
init requires msg.sender to equal owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to equal owner.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall when msg.sender is the owner.
msg.sender-derived addresses are compared against the ensure whitelist.
delegate reaches the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on balanceOf.
transferFrom performs an unchecked addition on balanceOf.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on allowance.
_mints executes the arbitrary mint unsafe operation.
batchSend computes the total with an unchecked multiplication.
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist bypass.
ensure reads the UNI constant for the whitelist bypass.
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure compares the from/to addresses against owner.
ensure falls back to the condition checker for non-whitelisted addresses.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
condition reads _onSaleNum for the sender address.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum for the source address.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance for the spender.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
_mints overwrites balanceOf for the spender.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true, whitelisting the address.
batchSend debits the sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
setTradeAddress writes the privileged tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns totalSupply from the supply argument.
constructor credits balanceOf of the deployer.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
transferFrom calls ensure as part of its guard sequence.
Parameter _to flows into transfer.
Parameter _value flows into transfer.
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into transferFrom.
Parameter _spender flows into approve.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
Parameter b is the calldata supplied to delegate.
Caller-supplied calldata reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter spender flows into the mint beneficiary.
Parameter addedValue flows unchecked into the minted balance.
Parameter saleNum flows into _saleNum in init.
Parameter token flows into _minSale in init.
Parameter maxToken flows into _maxSale in init.
Parameter _tos is iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is distributed by batchSend.
Parameter addr flows into tradeAddress.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
Loop-local recipient _to is credited in batchSend.
Local total is produced by the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address is computed inside ensure.
transfer ultimately mutates balanceOf through transferFrom.
The delegate calldata is attacker controlled while the guard only checks msg.sender.
